title: Feather Experience IR (feather.ir/0)
description: One experience: the next necessary interaction, as meaning. Generated from packages/intent/src/spec.ts. This schema checks structure; rules across nodes (one primary act, irreversible acts state their consequence, references resolve) are checked by validate() in @aleeforoughi/feather-intent.

experience.description: Names the experience; replies carry it back.

locale.description: BCP 47 language of the words in it.

revision.description: The caller's version: 0 (or absent) when opened, one more with each update.

resolved.description: Set when the experience is over: it collapses to its summary and artifact, and takes no more replies.

nodes.description: The interaction, as meaning. May be empty once resolved.

href.description: Where it is; rendered only as an http(s) link.

Text.description: Plain words. One line with no decision renders as text, never a card.

id.description: Stable within the experience; replies and references use it.

intent.description: What the human is doing here, in a few words. Required on act nodes.

importance.description: How much it matters. Default normal; critical is never hidden behind expansion.

reversible.description: Whether the effect can be undone. Default true; an act that states a consequence cannot be undone.

expandable.description: Detail on demand, behind "Why?". At least one entry.

why.description: The reason, in a sentence or two.
